title: Cold start and database initialization
preconditions: Fresh install or existing local database
expected: The app initializes local storage and renders a usable screen without a crash

title: Medication course and alarm policy
preconditions: Test medication with an optional course end date
steps: Evaluate an occurrence before and after its end date
expected: Occurrences after the course end are not scheduled

title: Prescription parsing and review
steps: Parse dosage, duration, and course dates
expected: Parsed values are editable and persisted only after confirmation

title: Camera and gallery permission denial
steps: Open prescription scan or medication photo
expected: The user receives an actionable error and the app remains usable

title: Release signing does not use debug credentials
preconditions: Configured production keystore in CI or local environment
expected: Release is signed with a production keystore and no debug fallback exists

title: Permission purpose and disclosure review
steps: Review camera, notifications, exact alarms, NFC, and medical-data disclosures
expected: Every permission has a user-facing purpose and matching store disclosure

title: Android release artifact
preconditions: Android SDK, production keystore, and dependencies
expected: A signed release artifact is produced without debug signing

title: iOS archive and signing
preconditions: macOS, Xcode, Pods, and signing credentials
expected: A valid signed archive is produced
